_comment: Backstop only. The 15-minute deletion guarantee is enforced by the TTL
sweeper in the worker; GCS lifecycle rules have a minimum granularity of
one day, so this cannot satisfy the requirement on its own. It exists to
catch objects orphaned by a worker that died mid-job, and to bound cost
if the sweeper ever stops running.

rule._comment: Abort resumable uploads abandoned by a killed worker.
